tool_input.description: Find web test client patterns in tests

tool_input.command:
python3 -c "
import re, json
src = open('docs/feature/wp5.md').read()
m = re.search(r'\`\`\`json\n(.*)\n\`\`\`', src, re.S)
data = json.loads(m.group(1))
tasks = data['tasks']
print('VALID JSON, %d tasks' % len(tasks))
for t in tasks:
    print(' -', t['id'], '| files:', len(t['files']), '| tests:', len(t['tests']), '| deps:', t['deps'])
# check no duplicate test file ownership
owned = [t['files'][0] for t in tasks]
print('dup owners:', [f for f in set(owned) if owned.count(f)>1] or 'none')
"
